name: TryAMM TapPay / OmniPay
purpose: Original payment orchestration and merchant checkout layer for TryAMM covering Stripe-first online checkout, subscriptions, wallets, marketplace settlement, creator payouts, tap-to-pay category flows, OmniCredits and regional payment routing through licensed providers.
positioning: Build an original TryAMM payments experience using regulated providers and original orchestration, not copied proprietary payment code or branding.

stripeUses: Billing plus Checkout Sessions for subscriptions
Stripe Connect Accounts v2 for eligible marketplace/creator payout structures
Apple Pay and Google Pay through Stripe where eligible
Stripe Tax only after required registrations are active
Terminal/tap-to-pay through approved Stripe SDKs/devices where eligible
security: secrets only in server-side environment/secret manager
primaryProviderStrategy.fallbackRule: When Stripe does not support a required local rail, merchant country, payout route or capability, route through an approved regional licensed provider instead of faking support.

methods: USSD or local methods through eligible provider
nigeria.rule: Check actual Stripe/account/provider eligibility before presenting a local method.

africa.rule: Country, currency, payout and local-method support are capability-driven, not assumed.

methods: Pix when Stripe account/capability is eligible
brazil.rule: Pix eligibility and Connect limitations must be checked at runtime.

latinAmerica.rule: Use provider capability matrix for currencies, local methods and payouts.

globalFallback.currency: localized when supported, otherwise disclosed settlement currency

phase1PartnerModel.rule: TryAMM orchestrates licensed/acquiring/payment providers rather than representing itself as an unlicensed processor or money transmitter.
capabilities: NFC/tap-to-pay through approved provider SDKs where available

coreFlows: merchant onboarding and KYC/KYB through regulated provider
paymentMethods: regional bank/mobile-money/USSD methods through approved providers

tapToPay.model: Use approved Stripe Terminal/Tap to Pay or other approved processor/device SDKs for NFC/contactless acceptance. TryAMM provides merchant UX, orchestration, receipts, analytics, tipping, fee display and business tools around the regulated rail.
features: fee pass-through only where lawful and disclosed

feesAndProfit.principle: Never publish a payment price below actual processor/network/compliance/support cost. Platform fees must be lawful, disclosed and configured per market/provider.
feesAndProfit.pricingRule: CostOps computes minimum viable fee and target contribution margin before pricing is exposed. No hidden fee markups.

stripeImplementationRules: Use Checkout Sessions for standard one-time checkout
Use Billing APIs plus Checkout Sessions for subscriptions
Use Connect Accounts v2 rather than deprecated account-type patterns
Check connected-account capability status before transfers/payments
Use dynamic payment methods rather than hard-coding non-Terminal payment_method_types
Use verified webhooks as payment truth
Do not enable Stripe Tax unless registrations are active
licensingPath: phase 2: expand multi-provider acquiring and regional payment methods
phase 3: obtain legal/regulatory advice for money-transmission/payfac/merchant-of-record roles before assuming them
phase 4: pursue licenses/registrations only where economically justified
productionGates: Stripe account and restricted server credentials
